title: AlphaLeek
tagline: Welcome  Hacker. Connect your GitHub, show your shadowy super skills   and claim an on-chain proof of your developer prowess.
description: This project started as a way for developers to transport their GitHub reputation on-chain by claiming a Developer Badge NFT. Main use case would be to make hiring easier by querying the chain for Badgeholders, and then IPFS for the detailed attributes. In the future, the attestation / porting of data to IPFS would be more decentralized.
how_its_made: Unfortunately due to time constraints, the project ended up in a very poor state, one that I am not proud of. Vercel isn't building for reasons I cannot replicate locally, so I unfortunately don't have a live demo either. I would choose the same technologies again, but start working a lot earlier.
